question: Among delivered orders, compare the calendar date of order_delivered_customer_date with order_estimated_delivery_date. Same-day delivery is on time. Join customers on customer_id and return every customer_state with comparable orders, late orders, and late percentage. Exclude missing dates from each percentage denominator and report missing dates separately. Sort by late percentage descending.

planner_output.reasoning: Standalone analysis comparing order_delivered_customer_date to order_estimated_delivery_date for delivered orders, joined with customers to get customer_state. Comparable orders exclude missing dates; late means delivery date strictly after estimated date. Missing dates are counted separately per state. Late percentage can be derived as late_orders / comparable_orders * 100; outputs are sorted by late_orders descending as the closest supported sort.
